title: 灯下通行
standfirst: 轨道上的红电车，灯架下的行人。照明划出道路，也勾出黑暗中的楼体与桥拱。
standfirstEn: A red tram on its tracks. People beneath a lit arch. Light marks the roadway and outlines towers and a bridge against the dark.
introduction: 红电车沿着两条轨道进入画面。另一个地方，地灯从下方照出曲面、孔洞与拼缝。夜间的光各有来处：车头，橱窗，招牌，窗内。它们先照见一些正在使用的地方，周围仍然暗着。
这十二幅照片从车辆之间的路面，经过树下的转角与悬在头顶的灯架，再把距离拉开。白色亮点斜穿楼体前方，窗格铺成网面，海湾把密集的灯分成两岸。最后，桥拱只留一道橙色的线。
introductionEn: A red tram enters the frame along two rails. Elsewhere, ground lights reveal curved surfaces, openings and seams from below. At night, light has separate sources: headlights, shop windows, signs and rooms. Each reveals a place in use while its surroundings remain dark.

These twelve photographs begin with the road between vehicles, pass a corner beneath trees and an illuminated arch overhead, then draw back. White flecks cross in front of a building; windows form a mesh; a bay separates dense lights along its shores. At the end, an orange line follows a bridge arch.

chapters.title: 车灯
chapters.text: 红色公交与摩托车挤在一起，敞篷巴士把乘客带到路面上方。距离降到街边，蓝色厢式车停在店灯前，灯光照着可以经过的地方。
chapters.textEn: A red bus and motorbikes crowd together. An open-top bus carries its passengers above the road. At street level, a blue van stands before shop lights that illuminate a place to pass through.

chapters.title: 路口
chapters.text: 树枝遮住招牌的一部分，尾灯把道路引向一扇圆窗。发光的门牌架悬在人群上方；看得清的是通道与名字，人留在较暗的位置。
chapters.textEn: Branches partly conceal a sign; tail lights lead towards a circular window. A lit arch hangs over the crowd. The passage and its name are visible while people remain in darker areas.

chapters.title: 轮廓
chapters.text: 斜飞的白点先让楼体前方的空气显露，近处窗格转成密集的线。距离拉开，海湾在灯光之间留出暗处，桥拱收成一道单独的亮边。
chapters.textEn: Slanting white flecks reveal the air in front of a building; nearby windows become a dense pattern of lines. From farther away, the bay leaves dark space between lights and a bridge arch narrows to a single illuminated edge.
